query:
UPDATE articles 
SET content = JSON_REPLACE(
  content,
  '$[0].type',
  'update_note'
)
WHERE slug = 'computer-hardware-why-scenic-designers-and-all-theatre-designers-need-to-care'
AND JSON_EXTRACT(content, '$[0].type') = 'paragraph'
AND JSON_EXTRACT(content, '$[0].text') LIKE '%Updated: February 2026%';
